intent_snapshot.goal: Execute ADR 0043 Slice 1 per docs/specs/retire-loop-daemon.spec.md: delete runtime/loop_daemon/, bin/imm-loop, skills/imm-loop/, runtime/decision_model/, scripts/decision-eval/, scripts/review-eval/, and their coupled specs/fixtures/tests; remove loop_interactions, answer_loop_interaction, and steer_loop_work_item across Host adapters, the loop field on imm-kernel inspect --json, and live tracker_approval/policy_auto confirmation admission; strictly reject loop and decision_models in v2 config (blocking batchConfigErrors/drive) while stripping them in config migrate --write; accept ADR 0043, supersede ADRs 0039/0040/0042, and sync active docs and Host bundles (BR-REQ-1, BR-REQ-2, BR-DEC-1..3, BR-OUT-1, BR-SCN-1..3).

acceptance.assertion: Per docs/specs/retire-loop-daemon.spec.md AC1 and BR-SCN-1 (agreed seams: tests/v4-runtime-launchers.test.ts, tests/packaged-contract-tool-surface.test.ts, tests/kernel-inspect.test.ts, tests/batch-agreement.test.ts, tests/acceptance-repeat-series.test.ts), runtime/loop_daemon/, bin/imm-loop, skills/imm-loop/, runtime/decision_model/, and runtime/host-core/loop_interactions.ts are deleted; v4_runtime.ts cli imm-loop status --json exits non-zero as an unknown command; MCP tools/list and Pi registered tools exclude loop_interactions, answer_loop_interaction, and steer_loop_work_item; imm-kernel inspect --json omits the loop key; verifyEnrollmentConfirmation and authorizeBatch reject tracker_approval and policy_auto while retaining user_session/native_gate; and runtime/kernel/acceptance_repeats.ts remains covered without scripts/review-eval/ (BR-REQ-1, BR-DEC-2).

Per docs/specs/retire-loop-daemon.spec.md AC2 and BR-SCN-2 (agreed seams: tests/layered-config.test.ts, tests/agent-roles-config.test.ts, tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts), loop and decision_models are removed from v2 FILE_KEYS and EffectiveConfig in layered_config.ts; a v2 user config with decision_models or project config with loop emits a config_invalid error on that key path, causes imm-kernel config --json to exit 1, and causes batchConfigErrors and startUnattendedBatch (drive) to fail closed with lane_config_invalid; and imm-kernel config migrate --write strips top-level loop and decision_models alongside retired herdr while preserving valid v2 keys (BR-DEC-3).

Per docs/specs/retire-loop-daemon.spec.md AC3 (agreed seams: tests/claude-host-package.test.ts, tests/antigravity-host-package.test.ts, tests/dist-docs-sync-contract.test.ts, tests/skill-dist-consistency.test.ts, plugins/immune-brain/tests/skill-registry-consistency.test.ts, tests/vocabulary-dead-reference-contract.test.ts, tests/pi-only-current-contracts.test.ts), scripts/decision-eval/, scripts/review-eval/, and their fixtures/specs/tests are deleted while .imm/audit/ and docs/*/archive/ stay untouched; ADR 0043 is status: accepted, ADRs 0039/0040/0042 are superseded by ADR-0043 with ADR 0038 intact, and ADR 0041/CONTEXT.md/BASELINE.md/fix-pr/config docs drop active Loop daemon and Decision model entries; Claude, Antigravity, and dist/ checks pass and npm pack --dry-run contains no imm-loop, loop_daemon, or decision_model files (BR-REQ-2, BR-DEC-2, BR-OUT-1).
